about: P2 round 3: the A/A runs Alex asked for on 2026-10-28 (via the coordinator), "Largest, A/A redone" and "More A/A servers". One job per system, drafted in the lab queue's job format for the operator to copy into queues; not a queue itself. Commit: d063274742fa4fa4cab5491297571d953b3cfa31 on branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (local; bundled from that checkout as before). Each job runs t3/jobs/aa.py. On Windows: the A/A run again, t3/plans/rr-aa-W.json unchanged (v2 twice in each program; the plan p2r3-rr-w ran in chain A15, so the round orders are the same), then the k-server A/A run, rr-aak-W.json. On Arch: the k-server A/A run, rr-aak-L.json. The k-server plans hold v2 seven times in each of the three programs: 21 servers per cell (the Windows campaign's count; Arch's has 22) and 294 windows, with the campaign's cells, rounds and windows (mixed-disjoint, m = 1,000 and 100,000, pair (111, 211), R = 7, 1.5 s windows after p2gen's 0.1 s lead-in, each server started once per size with a 1 s warm-up). It times the Release builds of p2r3-bringup-l and p2r3-bringup-w at 3ff814e50, the builds every round-3 record timed: aa.py refuses (exit 2) before the first window unless the clone is clean, each binary's sha256 is the bring-up's, no compiled source changed since 3ff814e50 (none did) and every plan is an A/A plan of that build. No build, no download. The analysis, t3/rr_results.py, is committed with the plans before the runs: the floor (per program and size, the A/A run's largest |d| over the rounds, set against each pair of neighbours in the campaign's ranking; on Windows from the A/A run done again) and the k-server run's statistics (descriptive; they do not enter the floor). aa-summary.json holds verdicts, shares, start-ups, memory and spacing, no rate. Peak resident memory of the 21 v2 servers at m = 100,000, from the A/A records' per-server peaks: about 1.35 GiB on Arch (7 x 44,800, 80,184 and 76,700 KiB) and 1.19 GiB on Windows (7 x 41,456, 68,984 and 68,232 KiB), plus p2gen. Either system may go first.

jobs.note: Start at least 15 minutes after boot and only once the quiet check passes (the coordinator's rule of 2026-10-28; in A15 the job began 33 s after boot and others above 10% of one CPU came until about 10 min after it). The A/A run again (84 windows, 6 servers per size), then the k-server A/A run (294 windows, 21 servers per size); server on CPU 14, p2gen on 2 to 13, the runner on 0 and 1; reads C:\Users\alext\lab\p2r3\build-3ff814e50, progs-3ff814e50 (p2v2.dll beside mserver-go.exe) and sets, writes only in LAB_OUT. expected_s from p2r3-rr-w's record (A15): 25 s from the job's start to the first run's session; that A/A run took 197 s for 96 windows (2.05 s each with its starts, warm-ups and stops), so 84 windows about 172 s; the k-server run at the campaign's spacing, 294 x 1.743 = 512 s, 42 warm-ups x 1.39 = 58 s, 42 starts x 0.23 = 10 s, preflight and the 10 s session clock about 16 s: about 597 s; together about 794 s, rounded up to 900. Reruns of host-spoiled rounds come on top (A15: 4.3 min); timeout_s three times expected_s. Boost off, the lab's default.
